name: PaddleOCR
author: Oxelis
description: Model pack for accurate text recognition: the PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 detection model and PP-OCRv6 small recognition model, with the ONNX Runtime library. The models are the work of the PaddleOCR authors and are installed from their original distribution by tools/fetch-ocr-assets.py; they are not part of Oxelis. Without this plugin, Oxelis falls back to Windows OCR.
